contexts.text: (Heavenly arcana in the Word.) AC 1748. AC 1756. AC 2048. AC 2177.
He to whom it is not given to know heavenly arcana...
Heavenly arcana have this, that although they are above all apprehension, still everyone can form for himself some idea about them...
He who knows what all the particulars involve will find therein heavenly arcana.
The Arcana Coelestia referred to. DLW 288. DLW 324. DLW 377. DP 151:end. DP 241:end. DP 254, etc. AR 5, etc. TCR 121. TCR 201, etc. SE 4620. SE 4630. SE 5192. SE 5600. SE 5643. DMin 4792.
(The Arcana Coelestia seen there.) See AR 875:15.
(Slow sale of the first volume of the Arcana Coelestia.)
